prompts.text: Which food opinion of yours would start a lively debate on a first date?
Share one dessert or order two and exchange the last bites?
We order something unfamiliar and both dislike it. Who admits it first?
A person who recommends a good snack earns more points than someone who picks the fanciest restaurant.
Tell me about the most ridiculous food combination you genuinely enjoy.
A shared meal gets more interesting when both people have strong opinions about the menu.
What snack would you bring to convince me your taste is better than mine?
We each have to choose a mystery ingredient for the other's sandwich. What are you picking?
Breakfast food at dinner or a full dinner for breakfast?
What's a dish you'd enjoy teaching someone to make, even if the kitchen gets messy?
